author: Bernan_Gaming
body:
My username is 1177bam.
  • I was banned on Aug. 22, 2015 at 6:40 AM (10 hours ago) .  I would like to be unbanned as I did not intentionally break the rules. I had flight turned on and did not mean to.  I have now read the rules and see that it is not allowed and what others are not allowed.
